metadata.description: kinitro.ai plugins for running kinitro.ai agents in Claude.

plugins.name: kinitro
plugins.description: Briefs a kinitro.ai agent from the platform at the right moments and mirrors each turn into kinitro.ai.

plugins.name: kinitro-cloud
plugins.description: Briefs a kinitro.ai agent in sessions that run no hooks module, such as plain claude.ai chats. No MCP server of its own, no chat mirror; stays silent where the kinitro plugin is active.
